name: Web search
description: Search the web and read pages.

providers.label: SearXNG
providers.description: Free, no key. Hexbot runs it in Docker on the daemon's computer. Until Docker runs, searches go to Tavily and Wikipedia.

providers.label: Tavily
providers.description: Free without a key, with lower limits. Add a key for more searches.

providers.label: Wikipedia
providers.description: Free, no key. Searches Wikipedia only.

providers.label: Marginalia
providers.description: Free. An independent search engine for the small web. Its shared key is often busy, so ask Marginalia for a free key of your own.

TAVILY_API_KEY: Tavily API key for web search and extract.
KEENABLE_API_KEY: Keenable API key for web search and page fetch.

fields.label: Your own SearXNG URL (optional)
fields.help: Leave empty and Hexbot runs SearXNG for you. Your instance must allow JSON results.

fields.label: Tavily API key (optional)
fields.help: Without a key, Tavily answers with lower limits.

fields.label: Marginalia API key (optional)
fields.help: Without one, Hexbot uses the shared key. Results are licensed CC BY-NC-SA.

fields.label: Exa API key
fields.help: Exa API key for AI-native web search and contents

fields.label: Brave Search subscription token
fields.help: Brave Search API subscription token (free tier: 2,000 queries/mo)

fields.label: Firecrawl API key
fields.help: Firecrawl API key for web search and scraping

fields.label: Parallel API key
fields.help: Parallel API key for AI-native web search and extract

fields.label: Keenable API key
fields.help: Keenable API key for web search and page fetch.

name: Google Workspace
description: Read and search Gmail, and draft email you send.

fields.label: Your own OAuth client ID (optional)
fields.help: A Desktop app client from Google Cloud. Leave empty to sign in through Hexbot's own.

fields.label: Its client secret (optional)
fields.help: Google gives Desktop app clients one; it goes with your own client ID.

name: Microsoft 365
description: Read and search Outlook, and draft email you send.

fields.label: Your own application (client) ID (optional)
fields.help: A Microsoft Entra app that allows public client flows. Leave empty to sign in through Hexbot's own.

name: Notion
description: Read and write pages and databases in your workspace.

fields.label: Notion API key
fields.help: Notion integration token (used by the `notion` skill)

name: X search
description: Search posts and profiles on X.

providers.label: SuperGrok or X Premium+
providers.description: Your SuperGrok subscription; X Premium+ includes it. Sign in with your xAI or X account, no key needed.

providers.label: xAI API
providers.description: Grok searches X and answers with the posts it cites. xAI bills each search.

providers.label: X API
providers.description: Posts straight from X's own search, without Grok. X bills each post it returns.

fields.label: xAI API key
fields.help: From the xAI console, API keys. Also used if a bot runs on xAI models.

fields.label: X API bearer token
fields.help: From the X developer console: your app, Keys and tokens, Bearer token.
